run_trainer: run the Trainer to train the context model for 15000 iterations with cross entropy loss
create_multimodal_encoder: create a MultimodalEncoder with 128 classes and 16 heads to encode face geometry and audio
create_context_model: create a ContextModel with 128 classes and 16 heads for autoregressive expression prediction
create_categorical_autoregressive_forwar: create a CategoricalAutoregressiveForwarder with a pre-trained encoder and context model to compute training loss
create_datareader: create a DataReader with segment length 64 to load face geometry and audio data
